sourceAttribution.revisionAccounting: Three initial node installations add three deltas. seal calls persistFamilies with the current prefix_evidence id; every registered family state receives that evidence. Each sealed prefix therefore adds one Feedback owner metadata revision even when the state payload is unchanged. Kernel.commit skips only a fully equal node, not changed evidence. Delta = 3 + acquiredPrefixes: STCK 3+6=9, SMLP 3+9=12, warmups 3+3=6.

A generic lazy standalone fallback could merit separate study, but it would not remove the three authoritative nodes or their provenance revisions. No cost attribution or correction is established here; any change requires a new freeze and validation window.
